name: nexusmind
description: NexusMind - 基于社会世界模型的多智能体舆情推演与决策辅助系统

scripts.setup:all: npm run setup:frontend && npm run setup:backend
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors green,cyan "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
scripts.backend: cd backend && uv run python run.py
